summary: Tallo (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6637599, CC BY 4.0) holds stem_diameter_cm and height_m for 498,838 individual trees of 5,163 species, which is what the log-diameter vs log-height exponent test needs. The Global Wood Density Database (Dryad 10.5061/dryad.234, CC0, 8,412 taxa) supplies wood density; a per-species elastic modulus table was not found in a repository (one Dryad wood-traits dataset may contain it, columns unverified). ForestGEO returned 403 and TRY is request-only.
next_step: Pre-register the exponent fit on Tallo (filter height_outlier = N, within-species and pooled); for the Greenhill height-cap clause, obtain pine elastic modulus from a wood-handbook source and join to Tallo Pinus records.
obstacles_confirmed: Elastic modulus is not in the wood density table (Dryad 10.5061/dryad.234 is density only).
Diameter and height together per stem are open only in Tallo among the assessor-named sources; FIA tables were not verified and ForestGEO is access-restricted.
